hazard: Insufficient alertness of healthcare staff to physical symptoms occluded by mental health issues

concerns.quote: That there is no proper provision for the care and supervision of prisoners who present with complex physical and/or mental health needs
concerns.hazard: lack of proper care and supervision of prisoners with complex physical and mental health needs

concerns.quote: That at present, if a prisoner is assessed as needing a four person unlock, and is within the Segregation Unit, there are insufficient prison staff to provide him with a proper regime and to unlock him after lunchtime
concerns.hazard: insufficient prison staff to provide proper regime and unlock prisoners in segregation

concerns.quote: That the use of New Psychoactive Substances (NPS) remains rife within the prison, and presentations such as Mr [name redacted] are not diminishing, and that the Substance Misuse Team requires further staff to be effective in future
concerns.hazard: continued prevalence of New Psychoactive Substances and inadequate staffing of Substance Misuse Team

concerns.quote: That the documentary tool for decision making between prison staff and healthcare staff, as to whether a prisoner is fit to remain in Segregation and should do so, is unclear in design or in use
concerns.hazard: unclear documentary tool for decision making between prison staff and healthcare staff regarding segregation fitness

concerns.quote: That healthcare staff are insufficiently alert to the issue that physical symptoms which require urgent medical attention may be occluded by mental health issues
concerns.hazard: insufficient alertness of healthcare staff to physical symptoms occluded by mental health issues

reports.title: Tammy Watkins: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust have recognised the need to fully review how and what physical healthcare is offered across all inpatient services and successfully recruited an Associated Director of Physical Healthcare last year. This is a strategic post and covers all three care groups. Their initial priority has been to scope all physical health models of care across inpatient services with the aim of understanding the unique needs of patients across our services. The next phase will look to address the associated
promises.summary: Recruit Associated Director of Physical Healthcare to review and improve inpatient physical healthcare

concerns.quote: Poor Quality Acute Physical Healthcare in the mental health setting Tammy's death demonstrates a further example of a failure by medical staff to recognise a deteriorating patient and a subsequent delay in escalating for acute secondary care intervention
concerns.hazard: preventable deaths due to failure to recognise deterioration in mental health patients

concerns.quote: Failure to Adhere to the National and Local National Early Warning Score (version 2) Policy This is a repeated theme identified at inquest and in previous Prevention of Future Death reports.

A lack of robust policy relating to Ingestion of Foreign Bodies I heard evidence that the Trust is in the process of drafting a policy, but it became clear during evidence that the policy is not yet sufficiently robust
concerns.hazard: unmanaged ingestion risk of foreign objects

concerns.quote: There was significant confusion in this case as to who should call a medical emergency and how information should be relayed to the ambulance service. It had been recognised early in the day by the Security Team that Tammy may require an out of grounds medical transfer, but it was not until much later in the afternoon, when Tammy was in cardiac arrest, that an ambulance was called
